_comment: Written form -> how the narrator should say it. Applied to TTS text only; captions keep the written form. Keys match whole words, case-sensitive. A value is a string for every engine, or an object with per-engine values (kokoro, chatterbox, default) and an optional ipa: cloned-voice takes are then checked with a phoneme recognizer and retaken until they match. Kokoro values can use phoneme markup [word](/phonemes/). vidyal.ai was matched to the owner's recording: VID-yaa-lay. Per-video overrides go in script.yaml under `lexicon`.
